description: Na₂CSbAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.69 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.24-1.36 Å. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.45 Å. As is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.77 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one C, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one C, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sb, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one As atom.
